component.name: Glyphforge
component.summary: Design terminal user interfaces in the terminal

description.p: Glyphforge is a visual design environment for terminal user interfaces that runs in the terminal. Interfaces are semantic components (panels, tables, inputs, charts) with layout and themes; artwork is drawn in cells and sub-cell pixels. Designs export to ANSI art, a YAML hand-off and starter code for Ratatui, Textual, Bubble Tea and Ink.
Coding agents use the same model through a command line and an MCP server; their changes can be reviewed and accepted in the editor.
First release: interface, cell and pixel editing, 47 components, symbols, prototypes, export and the MCP server.
